The differentiator is execution: 5+ years leading agile delivery for distributed engineering teams

prioritization, ways of working) that turns strategy into shipped software. Certified in Scrum and
SAFe; fluent in modern build tooling and cloud.

## Services

- **Hands-on AI Build** — design and build LLM applications, agentic workflows, RAG, and automations,
  from prototype to production.
- **Team Enablement & AI Coaching** — upskill teams on practical AI use, prompt craft, and new ways
  of working, and embed the habits.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does an AI Transformation Consultant do?
An AI Transformation Consultant helps organizations identify where AI creates real value, then
builds and ships it — combining AI strategy (use-case discovery, feasibility, ROI, governance) with
hands-on delivery (LLM applications, agentic workflows, automation) and the change-management
discipline needed to make adoption stick across teams.

### What makes Ahmed Chioua's approach different?
Ahmed pairs AI advisory with 9 years of enterprise delivery experience — as a certified Scrum
Master and SAFe Agilist — at Bell, BMW, and Bayer. AI recommendations come with the roadmapping,
prioritization, and delivery discipline needed to turn strategy into shipped software, not just a
slide deck or workshop.

### What services does Ahmed Chioua offer?
Four core services: AI Adoption Strategy & Roadmapping, AI-Augmented Delivery (embedding AI into
existing product and delivery workflows), Hands-on AI Build (LLM applications, agentic workflows,
RAG, and automation), and Team Enablement & AI Coaching.

### Which industries has Ahmed Chioua worked in?
Telecom (Bell), automotive (BMW), life sciences (Bayer), and retail (enterprise clients including
Disney, Carrefour, Casino, and Fnac via Symphony Retail AI), across 9 years of enterprise delivery
experience.
